summary: The agent implements a generally solid LightGBM pipeline with proper K-Fold cross-validation, log-transformation of the target, and out-of-fold prediction averaging. However, it fails to perform any meaningful feature engineering on domain-rich columns (like geography or fuel type), relies entirely on hardcoded hyperparameters without tuning, and has a minor data leakage issue by defining categorical levels using the combined train and test sets.
